additional_info.subject: ID0438317-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / R7 170002200] After Hard Reset Charger has issue CRM:00315002848
additional_info.body:
Hi Simon,
Please check why the main EcoG (KF211) in the dispenser is not reachable. Check if the Ethernet cable is properly inserted on the port on the back, not the front.
Check via Mobaxterm if you can access the KF211 (10.20.17.102).
You can also try rebooting and a miracle might happen and problem is solved.
If replacing the Ethernet cable doesn't work and KF211 is still not responding, please replace the KF211. And don't forget to use the companion to flash it.
Did you perhaps replace this KF211 previously and not configure it? You can also check by removing the Ethernet cable and connecting directly to your PC and check the IP.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.body:
Hi Simon,
First session didn't work due to Authentication invalid in DC3:
Second session in DC4 worked perfectly fine, someone stopped it remotely:
Third session, there was no StartTransaction sent and failed immediately after as it didn't get validated.
Fourth session again, everything went fine and it was stopped remotely in DC2:
Fifth session again everything went well:
Can you please check if anyone performed this action? I am very positive that we are not allowed to send this kind of command from the charger. Did you try to charge without backend to confirm if everything was fine?
I would start from here, if the sessions stop after 1min even without backend then we need to investigate this differently.
I will wait for your feedback.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

→ correct

→ ECO-G responds
Charging tests
→ performed multiple times without interruptions or errors
Customer's vehicles were able to charge without issues throughout the day.
No short circuits or other defects were detected.
The charger and dispenser are functioning without any disturbances.
